description: Wind velocity measurement using heterogeneous terrain representation by Terraformer is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Sungmoon Jung, Florida State University (fsu.edu). An extensive series of wind tunnel experiments were conducted in the Boundary Layer Wind Tunnel (BLWT) Experimental Facility (EF) at the University of Florida (UF) to investigate the effect of heterogenous terrain on wind flow and pressure distributions on building surfaces. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Wind tunnel, Heterogeneous terrain, Low-rise building model, Mid-rise building model, Terraformer, Aerodynamic roughness length. Published 2024-03-20. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
